scan.title: Select Devialet Expert amplifier
scan.description: The integration listened for local Devialet Expert status broadcasts. Select the amplifier to add.

manual.title: Connect to Devialet Expert
manual.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of a Devialet Expert non-Pro amplifier. It must be reachable on the same local network and broadcasting status packets.

reconfigure.title: Update Devialet Expert address
reconfigure.description: Enter the amplifier's current IP address or hostname. This is useful after a DHCP address change.

error.cannot_connect: No decodable Devialet status broadcast was received from this address. Check the address, network routing, and amplifier power.
error.invalid_volume_range: The minimum volume must be lower than the maximum volume.

abort.no_devices_found: No Devialet Expert non-Pro status broadcasts were found. Use manual setup if the amplifier is on another network segment.

init.title: Volume limits
init.description: Set the dB range exposed through the Home Assistant volume slider. The amplifier always retains its physical range of -97.5 dB to -10 dB.

error.invalid_volume_range: The minimum volume must be lower than the maximum volume.
